name: thirukkural
description: Thirukkural Tamil dataset: the Tamil text of all 1,330 kurals of the Thirukkural, each with the sources that carry it, its verification status, a sha256 of its exact text, and the ruling that settled it where sources disagree. Also: chapter and book structure, metrical analysis of every seer, the position of each kural in three 19th-century printed editions, the ruling ledger and the source registry. Separate configs carry G. U. Pope's 1886 English verse translation, the Drew and Lazarus English prose translation, V. V. S. Aiyar's 1916 English translation and Parimelazhagar's Tamil commentary, each row compared with a printed edition where one is available, and the commentary parsed by rule into word glosses, situation notes and the readings it reports. One config, embeddings_bge_m3, holds vectors a model computed from the text, labelled model_generated on every row; no text is model output.
citeAs: @dataset{gopalsamy_thirukkural_2026, author = {Gopalsamy, Ashwin}, title = {Thirukkural Tamil Dataset}, year = {2026}, version = {1.0.0}, publisher = {Hugging Face}, url = {https://huggingface.co/datasets/ashwingopalsamy/thirukkural-tamil-dataset}}
rai:dataCollection: Four Hugging Face datasets were retrieved as digital witnesses, with revision and sha256 recorded for every file (sources config); a fifth (TamilThagaval) is gated, only its README was retrieved, and none of its content is used. Three scanned printed editions on archive.org (Pope 1886, Lazarus and Mrugesa Mudaliyar 1885, Arumuga Navalar) are the verification witnesses. Tamil Wikisource is consulted in two forms. Its proofread மூலம் pages (source wikisource-mulam) are byte-identical to Chandrasekar's raw lines on 1,220 of 1,330 kurals, including their error at kural 51, and are grouped with lineage group L1. The seer-divided text of its Parimelazhagar edition, which Chandrasekar's dataset carries as parimelazhagar_wikisource.json, is lineage group L3.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Unicode NFC. Forbidden codepoints rejected (unassigned Tamil-block codepoints, ZWJ, ZWNJ, NBSP, private use). Deterministic cleaning rules only; no rule changes a Tamil letter. Disputed letters are settled in the ruling ledger, never by cleaning.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Candidate readings come only from cited witnesses. Machine reading of the scans locates each kural and compares the candidates; it never supplies text. Where witnesses and scans do not settle a reading, a ruling in the ledger records the candidates, evidence, time and a value hash. A reading typed from the print is keyed twice and must match. Every ruling's adjudicator is a person (adjudicator_kind human).
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Machine reading of the scanned Tamil editions: used only to locate kurals and compare candidate readings; it supplies no Tamil text
The aiyar1916_en text is machine-read from a scan of the 1916 book and may contain reading errors; each row's tier says how it was checked
tkcore.prosody, a rule-based kural venba checker (derived layer only)
BAAI/bge-m3 at revision 5617a9f61b028005a4858fdac845db406aefb181: the vectors in embeddings_bge_m3 are model output, computed from the canonical text; no text
rai:dataBiases: Numbering, order and section grouping follow the Parimelazhagar tradition; other commentators order and group differently.
rai:dataLimitations: The two metre checkers are rule-based; v0.3 takes the foot boundaries of a few kurals from an edition's seer division (Tamil Wikisource's Parimelazhagar text or a printed edition). Scan boxes can be offset by a line. verified_digital_only kurals have not been compared letter by letter with a print.
rai:dataUseCases: Exact quotation and citation by number or id
Grounding for retrieval and question answering
Evaluating whether language models quote classical Tamil exactly
rai:dataSocialImpact: An exact, checkable Tamil text of a widely quoted work, with the sources behind every reading, so a misquotation can be detected.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None. A classical text and bibliographic metadata.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Semantic versions with the same tag on GitHub and Hugging Face. Ids are permanent. Text corrections go through the ledger and ship as a new major version with a per-kural changelog.

field.name: print_match

field.name: book_match_share
field.description: English layers: the same share against the whole edition's machine-read text. High here but low on the page points to a mislocated page or another kural's text.

field.name: text_flags

), virama_after_vowel. A flag never changes the text.

recordSet.name: seer
recordSet.description: One row per seer (metrical foot) as checker v0.1 reads the text, each printed word one foot: the word, its scansion form, asai and foot name. Layer: derived.

field.name: kural_id
field.description: Kural id.

field.name: kural_number
field.description: Kural number.

field.name: line
field.description: 1 or 2.

field.name: position
field.description: Position in the kural, 1 to 7.

field.name: word
field.description: The word as printed in lines_ta, without the closing full stop.

field.name: scansion_form
field.description: The word as scansion reads it after junction rules (tkcore.prosody.join).

field.name: asai
field.description: Metrical syllables: ner or nirai, with their letters.

field.name: pattern
field.description: The asai kinds joined by spaces, e.g. 'nirai ner ner'.

field.name: foot
field.description: Foot class from the checker: thema, pulima, koovilam, karuvilam, kaai, kani, naal, malar, kaasu, pirappu.

field.name: foot_ta
field.description: Traditional foot name, e.g. புளிமாங்காய். Null when the foot is not a recognised venba foot.

field.name: foot_ok
field.description: Whether kural venba allows this foot here.

recordSet.name: derived
recordSet.description: Per-kural results of deterministic rules: the metre check, the search form and transliteration. Layer: derived.

field.name: kural_id
field.description: Kural id.

field.name: kural_number
field.description: Kural number.

field.name: metre_ok
field.description: Checker v0.1: True when the word-split text scans as kural venba with each printed word read as a foot (tkcore.prosody.check). Kept beside scansion_ok so the difference shows per kural.

field.name: word_shape
field.description: Words per line; venba needs [4, 3].

field.name: metre_problems
field.description: What checker v0.1 found. A failure is an annotation, never a reason to change text.

field.name: scansion_ok
field.description: Checker v0.3 (tkcore.prosody.scan): True when these letters scan as kural venba with the regrouping traditional scansion uses. Not rules alone in every case: where scansion_method is 'attested division', the foot boundaries come from Tamil Wikisource's Parimelazhagar text (L3) or a printed edition (scansion_licences says which).

field.name: scansion_method
field.description: How v0.3 scanned it: word (printed words as feet), rules (an ஆய்தம் syllable joins the foot before it, or a word is divided into two feet), attested division (foot boundaries from Tamil Wikisource's Parimelazhagar text, L3, or from the foot breaks printed in an edition; the letters are this dataset's), or none.

field.name: scansion_licences
field.description: Rules v0.3 applied, e.g. 'kutriyalikaram not counted', 'elision inside a written word', 'au read as one letter (கெள = கௌ)'.

field.name: scansion_problems
field.description: What v0.3 found when the kural does not scan. An annotation, never a reason to change text.

field.name: scansion_note
field.description: Why, in plain words, when the kural does not scan or is written split (form_ok false); null otherwise.

field.name: form_ok
field.description: False when a line has more printed words than feet (4, 3): the text is written split where the print joins words.

field.name: checker
field.description: Name and version of the v0.1 checker behind metre_ok and the seer config; the scansion_ fields come from tkcore.prosody.scan (v0.3).

field.name: search_lines_ta
field.description: lines_ta with rule C13 (ெள to ௌ) so Tamil search finds கௌ; equals lines_ta elsewhere.

field.name: search_rule
field.description: C13 where the search form differs, else null.

field.name: translit_iso15919
field.description: search_lines_ta in ISO 15919, letter by letter (tkcore.translit). A reading aid, not the text.

field.name: translit_plain
field.description: translit_iso15919 with diacritics removed, for ASCII search.

field.name: letters_per_line
field.description: Tamil letters (aksharas) per line of lines_ta.

recordSet.name: echo_graph
recordSet.description: Kural-to-kural edges: kurals that share rare words, with the words and their frequency, and kurals in the same chapter. Layer: derived.

field.name: source
field.description: Kural id at one end; joins kurals.id.

field.name: target
field.description: Kural id at the other end.

field.name: kind
field.description: shared rare word, or same chapter.

field.name: weight
field.description: For shared rare words: the sum of inverse document frequencies of the shared words. Null for same chapter.

field.name: shared_keys
field.description: The shared words, as comparison keys.

field.name: doc_freq
field.description: For each shared word, how many kurals contain it.

recordSet.name: parimelazhagar_struct
recordSet.description: Parimelazhagar's commentary read as data, by rule: the kural's words in his prose order with his gloss for each phrase, the situation note (turai) for the love verses, how he groups kurals inside a chapter, his statement of what a verse teaches, the variant readings he reports and his stance on them, the other commentators he cites, and the figures, grammar and works he names. Every value is a span copied from the commentary in parimelazhagar_ta (same carrier, same MIT terms, same unidentified printed edition); nothing is paraphrased and no model is involved. Layer: derived.

field.name: kural_id
field.description: Kural id; joins kurals.id and parimelazhagar_ta.kural_id.

field.name: coverage
field.description: As in parimelazhagar_ta: complete, partial (the word gloss is missing in the carrier) or missing (the carrier row is withheld and nothing is kept from it).

field.name: pada_urai
field.description: Word-by-word commentary in his order: head = the kural's words as he splits them (sandhi undone), gloss = his explanation of that phrase.

field.name: turai
field.description: Situation note as written at the head of the row (who speaks, to whom, when); love section only. Null if none.

field.name: turai_resolved
field.description: The situation note that applies: turai itself, or the one 'இதுவும் அது' (same as above) points back to. Null when the note it points to is in a withheld row.

field.name: turai_same_as
field.description: Kural id whose note 'இதுவும் அது' refers to; null when the note is the row's own.

field.name: group_end
field.description: Set on the last kural of a group: 'இவை N பாட்டானும் … கூறப்பட்டது', the N kurals ending here treat one sub-topic.

field.name: summary
field.description: His sentences stating what this verse establishes ('இதனான் … கூறப்பட்டது').

field.name: other_commentators
field.description: Sentences reporting other commentators' readings or interpretations ('… என்பாரும் உளர்').

field.name: reported_readings
field.description: Variant readings he reports. stance: reported (others read it), also_a_reading (he admits it), conditional (he explains it if read so), rejected (he argues against it). Fragments, not full verses; they do not touch the canonical text.

field.name: figures
field.description: Figures of speech he names (உவமை, உருவகம், உபசாரம், எடுத்துக்காட்டு). Precise but sparse: many figures he does not name.

field.name: grammar_notes
field.description: Grammar he points out (ஆகுபெயர், உம்மை, அசைநிலை, தொகை …), first sentence per term.

field.name: cites_works
field.description: Other works he cites (Tolkappiyam, Sanskrit treatises …).

field.name: head_letter_coverage
field.description: Share of the kural's letters the heads reproduce, order-free: a parse check, 1.0 = every letter accounted for.

field.name: flags
field.description: Carrier faults and parse notes: vilakkam_unclosed, turai_missing_open_paren, leading_paren_not_turai, no_word_gloss_marker, head_found_by_verse_words (no separator before a head, so its start was found by matching the verse), head_boundary_unclear, heads_carry_extra_words (the carrier repeats a phrase, so a head holds words that are not the verse's), withheld and commentary_of_<kural id> (the carrier row is another kural's commentary), turai_refers_to_withheld_row ('same as above' after a withheld row, so turai_resolved is null).

field.name: source_id
field.description: The dataset that carries the commentary; joins sources.source_id.

field.name: locator
field.description: File, row and column of the commentary in that dataset.

field.name: source_sha256
field.description: sha256 of the carrier file as retrieved.

field.name: commentary_sha256
field.description: sha256 of the exact commentary text that was parsed (UTF-8); null where the row is withheld.

field.name: method
field.description: Parser and version (tkcore/parimel_struct.py).

field.name: model_generated
field.description: Always false.

recordSet.name: quote_keys
recordSet.description: Keys for checking a quotation: the exact hash, a comparison key that ignores spacing, punctuation and how words are joined, per-line and opening keys, and ready citations. Layer: derived.

field.name: kural_id
field.description: Kural id; joins kurals.id.

field.name: number
field.description: Kural number.

field.name: text_sha256
field.description: sha256 of the exact text; equals kurals.text_sha256.

field.name: compare_key
field.description: Tamil letters only, NFC, கௌ as one codepoint, pulli-plus-vowel joins written as the printed join. Two quotes with the same key have the same letters.

field.name: compare_key_sha256
field.description: sha256 of compare_key.

field.name: line1_key
field.description: compare_key of the first line.

field.name: line2_key
field.description: compare_key of the second line.

field.name: opening_key
field.description: compare_key of the first two words, to find a kural from its opening.

field.name: citation_ta
field.description: Citation in Tamil: kural number, chapter number and name, position.

field.name: citation_en
field.description: Citation in English, with the chapter title where Pope 1886 prints one.

field.name: permalink
field.description: The kural's web page, https://ashwingopalsamy.github.io/thirukkural-tamil-dataset/kural/<number>/.

field.name: permalink_ta
field.description: The same page as permalink: one page per kural carries the Tamil text and the English translations.

field.name: permalink_en
field.description: The same page as permalink.

field.name: base_url_is_placeholder
field.description: True only in a build made before the site address was set; false in every release.

recordSet.name: sound_index
recordSet.description: The sound of each kural by rule: letter weights per line, asai and seer patterns, monai (initial alliteration), edukai (second-letter rhyme between lines) and end rhyme. Layer: derived.

field.name: kural_id
field.description: Kural id; joins kurals.id.

field.name: letters_per_line
field.description: Per line: short-vowel letters (kuril), long-vowel letters (nedil) and pulli consonants (ottu).

field.name: asai_pattern
field.description: Asai of every seer: NE for ner, NI for nirai, seer separated by |.

field.name: seer_pattern
field.description: Foot name of each seer (tkcore.prosody).

field.name: venba_ok
field.description: Checker v0.1 (tkcore.prosody.check): whether the word-split text scans as kural venba with each printed word read as a foot. derived.scansion_ok has the v0.3 verdict.

field.name: monai
field.description: Per line: which seer alliterate with the first, and the named monai pattern where one fits.

field.name: edukai
field.description: Whether the second letters of the two lines rhyme (edukai).

field.name: end_letters
field.description: Last letter of each line.

field.name: end_rhyme
field.description: Whether the two lines end on the same letter.

field.name: agreement_with_chandrasekar_seers
field.description: Share of seer names that agree with the Chandrasekar yaappu analysis; null where it has none.

field.name: method
field.description: How the row was computed.

recordSet.name: kuralbench_lite
recordSet.description: KuralBench-lite: can a model quote a kural exactly? Two tasks over all 1,330 kurals, built by fixed templates: quote a kural by its number, and give the second line from the first. Score letter by letter with compare_key (tkcore.kuralbench.score), never with a model. Harness configs for Inspect and lm-evaluation-harness are in the GitHub repository under evals/. Every row carries the canary. Layer: tasks.

field.name: task_id
field.description: <task>:<kural_id>.

field.name: task
field.description: quote_by_number or complete_second_line.

field.name: kural_id
field.description: Kural id; joins kurals.id.

field.name: kural_number
field.description: Kural number.

field.name: prompt
field.description: The user message, from a fixed English template with the kural number or its first line filled in.

field.name: target_ta
field.description: The expected answer, copied from kurals.lines_ta: the whole kural, or its second line.

field.name: canary
field.description: The canary string (see the card). Keep it with any copy of these rows.

recordSet.name: tasks
recordSet.description: Evaluation items with answer keys, built from the verified text by rule: complete the second line, name the chapter, verify a quote (exact or a real attested variant), and fill a masked word. Altered items whose reading is carried only under CC-BY-SA are left out. Layer: tasks.

field.name: task_id
field.description: Task id, <kural_id>:<type>[:...].

field.name: kural_id
field.description: Kural id; joins kurals.id.

field.name: type
field.description: complete_second_line, identify_chapter, verify_quote or cloze.

field.name: prompt_ta
field.description: The prompt, in Tamil text taken from the dataset.

field.name: choices
field.description: Choices for multiple-choice items; null otherwise.

field.name: answer
field.description: The answer key.

field.name: note
field.description: For an altered verify_quote item: which attested reading it is.

field.name: canary
field.description: The dataset's canary string, the same on every row (BIG-bench practice): if a model can complete it, this file was in its training data. Keep it when you copy the tasks.

recordSet.name: agent_card
recordSet.description: One compact JSON object per kural, as a string, for an agent to hand to a model: text, hash, citations, chapter, status and what it means, ruling, metre (metre_ok is checker v0.3, as derived.scansion_ok), available layers and caveats. Layer: agents.

field.name: kural_id
field.description: Kural id; joins kurals.id.

field.name: card
field.description: The card as compact JSON.

recordSet.name: merkle_proofs
recordSet.description: A Merkle inclusion proof per kural (RFC 9162, SHA-256) against the two roots in MANIFEST.json and the card: the exact tree pins the text byte for byte, the letters tree pins its compare_key so a quote that differs only in spacing or punctuation also checks. Anyone can verify a quote offline with one root and the 5 to 11 hashes here. Layer: agents.

field.name: kural_id
field.description: Kural id; joins kurals.id.

field.name: kural_number
field.description: Kural number.

field.name: leaf_index
field.description: Position of the kural's leaf in both trees, 0 to 1329 (kural number minus 1).

field.name: tree_size
field.description: Leaves in each tree: 1330.

field.name: exact_path
field.description: Audit path in the exact tree, hex SHA-256, leaf to root. The leaf is canonical JSON {id, n, text} of kurals.text_ta.

field.name: letters_path
field.description: Audit path in the letters tree. The leaf is canonical JSON {id, n, key} with key = quote_keys.compare_key.

recordSet.name: embeddings_bge_m3
recordSet.description: Model-generated: one vector per kural, computed from kurals.text_ta by BAAI/bge-m3 at a pinned revision. Numbers, not text. For search and clustering; never a source for a kural's words. Layer: model.

field.name: kural_id
field.description: Kural id; joins kurals.id.

field.name: kural_number
field.description: Kural number.

field.name: model_id
field.description: The model, as named on the Hugging Face Hub.

field.name: model_revision
field.description: The model's Hub commit that computed the vector.

field.name: dim
field.description: Length of vector.

field.name: dtype
field.description: Precision the vector was saved in: float16. Each value is stored here as float32 without change, for tools that cannot read float16.

field.name: source_field
field.description: The text that was embedded: kurals.text_ta, with no prompt or prefix.

field.name: source_text_sha256
field.description: sha256 of that input string, equal to kurals.text_sha256. The build refuses the vectors when they differ.

field.name: vector
field.description: The embedding, L2-normalised: compare two kurals by dot product.

field.name: model_generated
field.description: Always true: a model computed this row.

recordSet.name: scan_locations
recordSet.description: Where each kural is printed in three editions scanned on archive.org: page image and box. Positions only; no text comes from this config. Layer: evidence.

field.name: kural_id
field.description: Kural id.

field.name: kural_number
field.description: Kural number.

field.name: edition
field.description: pope1886, lazarus1885 or navalar.

field.name: source_id
field.description: Registry id of the scan (sources config).

field.name: archive_item
field.description: archive.org item identifier.

field.name: leaf
field.description: Leaf index: the number in the JP2 file name.

field.name: image_file
field.description: Path of the page image inside the item's _jp2.zip.

field.name: bbox
field.description: Box around the kural in that image's pixels: x0, y0, x1, y1.

field.name: located_confidently
field.description: True when the box is within 3 leaves of the expected page and its text distance is under the 90th percentile.

field.name: ocr_distance_ratio
field.description: Edit distance per letter between the machine-read text in the box and the kural. Lower is closer.

recordSet.name: ledger
recordSet.description: Every recorded ruling on text or names: the candidate readings with their sources, the evidence, who decided and when. Layer: evidence.

field.name: ledger_id
field.description: adj:NNNNN.

field.name: subject
field.description: What was ruled on: a kural id, adhikaram:N or iyal:scheme:N.

field.name: field
field.description: lines_ta or name_ta.

field.name: decision
field.description: chose_candidate, transcribed_from_crop (typed from the print, double-keyed) or structure_ruling.

field.name: value
field.description: The ruled value: two lines for a kural, one element for a name.

field.name: value_sha256
field.description: sha256 of the ruled value as recorded in provenance/ledger/adjudications.jsonl.

field.name: candidates
field.description: Readings that were on the table, each with the witnesses that carry it.

field.name: evidence
field.description: Evidence cited: kind (scan_crop, print_comparison, wikisource_revid, scansion, note), reference and hash.

field.name: adjudicator
field.description: Who decided.

field.name: adjudicator_kind
field.description: Always human.

field.name: double_keyed
field.description: True when the value was typed from the print twice and the keyings matched.

field.name: decided_at
field.description: UTC time of the ruling, ISO 8601.

field.name: rationale
field.description: The reason recorded with the ruling.

field.name: supersedes
field.description: An earlier ruling this one replaces, if any.

recordSet.name: sources
recordSet.description: Every source the build identified: the witnesses cited in provenance, and two listed for completeness that no row cites (tamilthagaval, identified but not retrieved; ref:wikipedia-tirukkural, consulted for iyal ranges only, no text copied). Each with what it is, its lineage group, declared licence and retrieved file hashes (null where a file was not retrieved). Layer: evidence.

field.name: source_id
field.description: Id used in provenance.

field.name: title
field.description: Name of the source.

field.name: kind
field.description: digital_witness, scan_witness, reference, or not_retrieved (identified, data not retrieved, not a witness).

field.name: lineage_group
field.description: Sources in the same group descend from one upstream.

field.name: url
field.description: Where it was retrieved.

field.name: revision
field.description: Commit or revision retrieved.

field.name: declared_license
field.description: The carrier's own declared licence. It does not license public-domain text inside it.

field.name: rights_note
field.description: Notes on rights.

field.name: files
field.description: Retrieved files with sha256, size and time.

recordSet.name: variants_atlas
recordSet.description: Every attested reading of every kural, classified against the canonical text, with its witnesses and the ruling that decided it. Readings carried only under CC-BY-SA are in variants_atlas_sa. Layer: evidence.

field.name: kural_id
field.description: Kural id; joins kurals.id.

field.name: reading_id
field.description: Id of this reading, <kural_id>#r<n>; r0 is the canonical text.

field.name: text
field.description: The reading exactly as its witnesses carry it, after cleaning rules that never change a letter.

field.name: status
field.description: canonical, formatting variant, encoding variant, metrical form, alternate reading, rejected reading (ledger ruling or print comparison), or corrupt.

field.name: same_letters_as_canonical
field.description: True when the reading has the canonical letters and differs only in spacing, punctuation, markup or encoding.

field.name: ledger_id
field.description: The ruling that decided between this reading and the canonical one, if any.

field.name: sources
field.description: Every witness that carries this reading, with file, row and column.

field.name: carrier_licences
field.description: Declared licences of those witnesses (SPDX).

field.name: text_sha256

field.description: Kural id; joins kurals.id.

field.name: reading_id
field.description: Id of this reading, <kural_id>#r<n>; r0 is the canonical text.

field.name: text
field.description: The reading exactly as its witnesses carry it, after cleaning rules that never change a letter.

field.name: status
field.description: canonical, formatting variant, encoding variant, metrical form, alternate reading, rejected reading (ledger ruling or print comparison), or corrupt.

field.name: same_letters_as_canonical
field.description: True when the reading has the canonical letters and differs only in spacing, punctuation, markup or encoding.

field.name: ledger_id
field.description: The ruling that decided between this reading and the canonical one, if any.

field.name: sources
field.description: Every witness that carries this reading, with file, row and column.
